BiblicalUsage: The word means to contract or roll together, and Hezekiah uses it of his own life: I have cut off like a weaver my life, he will cut me off with pining sickness, from day even to night wilt thou make an end of me.
TheologicalSignificance: I read the weaver's thread as the measure of a life God holds in His hand.
